notes: Jashore district portal 'যোগাযোগ ব্যবস্থা' (বিমানবন্দর): the airport stands in the district town beside Jashore Cantonment and serves the Jashore-Dhaka route for passengers from Khulna and nearby districts; upazila not set (the page says 'জেলা সদরে'). The Kushtia and Jhenaidah pages also name it ('যশোর বিমান বন্দর') as the nearest airport for flights from Dhaka. Named on a portal page, not a registry entry; no address/coordinates/contact.
Satkhira district portal 'যোগাযোগ': the central bus terminal from which the DC office is reached by van or rickshaw. Named on a portal page, not a registry entry; no address/coordinates/contact.
